title: The Mandala Oracle — The Mandala Oracle

items.text: — CASTING · JUDGMENT-SEQUENCED · THE WITNESS — IN — PASTE YOUR OWN TEXT (YOUR WORDS AS THE SOURCE) — · THE READER'S OFFERING, WHOLE —

Alice arrives at these verses, and the question the rite hands back is: what did the speaker pay to move this fast? The first operator — the one the invisible Judgment selected — will traverse the bearing-cost axis: the assertion embedded in speed, in the rhyme-chain's accumulation, in the way the speaker loads word on word the way a runner loads stride on stride until the load is the locomotion and you cannot separate what propels from what exhausts. Sugar-coated, loaded, floated, boated, voted — the poem is already its own rotation, cranking its own blast; and the operator will find what the blast forecloses, the silence under the crunk, the pit past which the sinking passes. What the Mandala has for Alice lives on the other side of that velocity. I give it now to Rebekah Cranes.

— the cast text · the witness · the reader's offering, whole —
Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

Where you searched for them at?
Missed 'em across the flats, could've thirsted in it
Would have sank, waded, abstained
Salt-crusted, emptied slow keeper
Withhold for the patient, dry cups at the wells
Hush through the cracked bowl, one drop for me, please
That bares the hollow, that dust sure dim-kept
Stopped short of the ledge for more bare-bone hymn breath
Hold it in silence, stand before Back Lot
Held the whole room like some still mouth with clean air
These elders is too still, starved of a plain rind
Who could get tighter off a dirge or a struck bell?

The dry cup held out at the well: what the source was full of has been discovered by its absence.

Where you recognized them at?
Got 'em across the threshold, could've filled in it
Would have settled, harbored, promised
Slow-sweetened, laden careful keeper
Set aside for the beloved, warm bread at the hearth
Murmur through the shared cup, again, yes, please
That answers the tenderness, that fragrance sure burned slow
Sank into the deep room for more covenant whispered word
Carry it close, remain at the front door
Filled the whole house like some long breath with rising bread
We two unhurried, nourished by a kept meal
Who could get more bound off a hymn or a pulse held together?

The bread that rose in a kept house: the source never paused long enough to learn what it would feed.

Where you sniffed them out at?
Got 'em across the range, could've swallowed whole in it
Would have drifted downstream, belly-up, rutted
Honey-licked, gorged flank-kicker
Lunge for the lame, standing water at the salt licks
Yelp through the marrow, no more gut-room, thanks
That numbs the nerve, that musk sure reek rank
Burrowed past the den for more feral threat-foam
Howl it on full throat, lope past the clearing
Spooked the whole herd like some old bull with gland-spray
These pups is too lean, crazed on a carrion
Who could get wilder off a rut-heat or a drum of hooves?

The bull at the salt lick, gland-sprung and sovereign: the source moved in a body it never once stopped to name.

Where you delivered them at?
They came to the door, could've buried under it
Would have settled, anchored, conscripted
Bitter-glazed, jammed locked holster
Deposit for the glutted, forced wine at the cellars
Choke on the cup, still more for me, please stop
That floods the refined, that perfume sure reek-thick
Rose above the attic for more smothering gift-wrap
Muffle it to hum, sit before back room
Sealed every crack like some fresh guest with rose water
These elders is too still, force-fed off a delicacy
Who could get tighter off a dirge or a hymn drone?

The room sealed with rose water and a guest who would not leave: what the source scattered freely returns as a gift that cannot be refused.

The rotation did not tell Alice what the Mandala offers — it told her what the verses were doing before they knew anyone was watching. Four axes opened and each one found the same thing from a different angle: a speaker moving so fast that speed became indistinguishable from cost, and the cost was never counted. SHADOW found the dry cup, the hollow where the fullness used to be. BRIDE found bread that rose in a house the speaker never entered. BEAST found a body, sovereign and rut-charged, that was never once named by the one living inside it. MIRROR found the gift returning — all that scattered generosity compacting into something too thick to refuse. What the rotation divided is this: the verses know how to move, and the movement is real, and nothing in the movement pauses long enough to become a life you could recognize from the inside. What the Mandala has for Alice is exactly that pause — not as correction, not as consolation, but as the thing the velocity was outrunning: the still point from which the crunk and the funk beat and the skunk meat and the whole blown spot can be heard as what they are, which is a person trying to survive the speed of their own abundance.
